truck.label: Truck unavailable
truck.title: TRK029 failed a roadside inspection near Oshawa
truck.why: A brake defect was found. TRK029 is out of service with Load #4562 on board.

driver.label: Driver unavailable
driver.title: Karen Campbell (TRK037) is unwell and has stopped near Barrie
driver.why: She cannot drive again today. Load #4577 needs another driver.

loading.label: Loading delay
loading.title: Crane breakdown at Great Lakes Steel, Hamilton
loading.why: Loading of TRK042 is delayed by 3 hours.

route.label: Route delay
route.title: Hwy 401 eastbound closed at Belleville after a collision
route.why: Expected to reopen in about 3 hours. Loads heading east past Belleville are delayed.

supplier.label: Supplier delay
supplier.title: Lakeshore Truck Service: repair parts delayed 24 hours
supplier.why: TRK015, TRK038 and TRK049 leave the shop a day later than planned. Loads that depend on them must be re-covered.

payment.label: Customer payment delay
payment.title: Northline Retail will pay invoice INV-10421 ($93,200) 21 days late
payment.why: Their payables team is holding payments after a system change. Revenue and profit do not change; cash does.

urgent.label: Additional urgent order
urgent.title: Maple Fresh Foods added an urgent order for tonight
urgent.why: 22 pallets, Brampton to Montreal, due 11:30 PM. No truck is assigned yet.
